description: Generate portable memory payload for sub-agent injection. Formats institutional memory into compact or gate payloads that fit in Task tool prompts.

agent_role.description: Sub-agent role for relevance filtering (e.g., 'reviewer', 'deployer') — reserved for Phase 3

format.description: Output format: full (rich markdown), compact (~500 tokens, one-line per scar), gate (~100 tokens, blocking scars only)

max_tokens.description: Token budget for payload (default: 500 for compact, 100 for gate, unlimited for full)

plan.description: What the team is about to do (e.g., 'review auth middleware', 'deploy edge function')

project.description: Project namespace (e.g., 'my-project'). Scopes sessions and searches.

name: prepare_context
